media.prompt: Describe this picture in three sentences: the subject, the setting and the light. Then list anything in it that looks physically wrong. (Picture: this box's Iris-3B fox render.)
media.note: An accurate description, and it caught the Iris render's real fault (the stylised steam plume). Faults: it puts the steam at the fox's nose, when it floats well above, and its claim that breath only shows below -20 C is wrong; the list was cut at 400 tokens. The answer is set in type on the card. Apache-2.0.
